description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. 
 
 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! 
 
 
 Job Description 
 Position Overview 
 As a Software Engineer at Rockwell Automation, you will work on FactoryTalk Optix, industry-leading visualization software known for its flexibility and ease of use. FactoryTalk Optix is HMI software that allows users to design applications to control the production process in a variety of environments. These applications can be deployed to various targets, including OptixPanels, ASEM 6300 industrial computers, or user-provided machines running Optix Runtime Tools on either Windows or Linux.
 You will contribute to subsystem implementation, testing, and maintenance while growing your technical skills with support from more experienced engineers. You will participate in the development lifecycle, collaborate with your team to deliver assigned work, and help ensure that developed products meet requirements and quality standards. You will work with local and global teams and perform software testing tasks including test development, execution, troubleshooting, and documentation.
 When you join our software development group, you become part of a team that believes in knowledge sharing and collaboration and that is committed to using reliable and well-thought-out engineering and software development practices (such as Agile/SCRUM and SAFe) and technology to overcome any challenge.
 We are looking for someone who brings curiosity and a team-oriented approach. You will communicate openly and continue developing your knowledge of software engineering, computer engineering, and test automation practices.
 You will report to a Software Engineering Manager.

 Your Responsibilities: 
 Contribute to feature requirements and documentation, ensuring information needed for software development and test cases is captured clearly
 Implement software features and enhancements based on established designs and requirements
 Document code and technical decisions clearly for maintainability and team collaboration
 Develop and execute unit tests; report, analyze, debug, and correct software issues with guidance as needed
 Participate in reviews of documents, designs, code, test cases, and user documentation
 Plan, develop, and execute test cases and automated tests to help ensure appropriate functional test coverage
 Verify that documented test cases and specifications validate documented software requirements
 Perform product testing, document results, and follow up on issues found during testing
 Investigate the origin and cause of software anomalies with support from the team
 Contribute ideas for improving software development practices, development tools, and test automation
 Learn and apply relevant technologies and standards to solve engineering challenges
 Communicate technical concepts clearly, both verbally and in writing
 Develop familiarity with industrial control system concepts and how they apply to FactoryTalk Optix
 
 The Essentials - You Will Have: 
 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience
 Legal authorization to work in the US is required.
 
 The Preferred - You Might Also Have: 
 Typically requires 2 years of relevant technical experience
 Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent
 Experience in a software product development environment
 Working knowledge of C++, C#, or TypeScript programming languages
 Familiarity with Qt, .NET, or React frameworks
 Experience creating, configuring and managing container infrastructure (Kubernetes, Helm, Docker)
 Experience designing, developing, and maintaining applications that leverage MariaDB, including database schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
 Experience using AI Models for design, debugging and implementation
 Experience creating or updating GitHub Actions
 Experience with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code IDEs
 Experience documenting and reviewing designs
 Familiarity with Linux/WSL
 
 What We Offer: 
 Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision
 401k
 Paid Time off
 Parental and Caregiver Leave
 Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life.
 To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com .
 
 This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.
 At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. 

 #LI-Hybrid
 #LI-LifeAtRok
 #LI-SB1
 
 
 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. 
 
 If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at +1 (844) 404-7247.
 
 Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.
